model.name: On Cloudmonster Void - Men's
model.description:
'

Stay fresh and on the move with the ON Cloudmonster Void. Designed for everyday wear, this updated take on ON‚Äôs iconic silhouette features a lightweight haptic mesh upper that boosts breathability and adds a sleek, modern edge. The same CloudTec sole and Helion superfoam cushioning deliver soft, responsive comfort with every step. Durable TPU eyelet stays and upgraded branded details bring structure and style, while rubber pads on the outsole keep your grip strong wherever you go. Whether you‚Äôre heading out or winding down, the ON Cloudmonster Void is built to keep you feeling your best.

  • TPU eyelet stays offer durability.
  • Weight 10.2 oz.

Long days on your feet call for comfort that feels soft, light, and easy to wear. The On Cloudmonster Void refreshes one of the brand's standout silhouettes with a breathable haptic mesh upper, plush underfoot cushioning, and upgraded details that bring a clean, modern finish to your everyday rotation.

  • Lightweight haptic mesh upper for breathable comfort
  • CloudTec sole helps deliver a soft, smooth ride
  • Helion superfoam cushioning adds responsive comfort
  • TPU eyelet stays provide added durability and structure
  • Rubber pads on the outsole help maintain grip
  • Weight: 10.2 oz.

Cushioning & Road Feel

Built around On's CloudTec sole and Helion superfoam, this silhouette leans into a cushioned feel without losing its sense of response. The result is a smooth, comfort-first ride that works well for everyday movement, from quick outings to all-day wear.

sizeChart.sizeChartTipTx:
Unfortunately, there is no international sizing standard. Sizes vary from country to country. Please use the tables above only as a guide to help you in ordering the correct size. Please note that all sizes, are listed and sold in US sizes., |

Women's shoes are made on a narrower last (the foot-shaped form used in making shoes) than men's. In addition, the heel on a woman's shoe is narrower than the forefoot width. Men's shoes have the same width at the forefoot and heel. The medium width for women's shoes is B, while the medium width for men's shoes is D.

Women can wear men's shoes by converting their size to men's by subtracting 1.5 from their numeric size. For example, if you are a size 8 in women's, you would try a 6.5 in men's sizes. This is a loose conversion and doesn't change the difference in width and forefoot-to-heel ratios.

, | If you still have questions about fit or sizing please contact Customer Service., | If your measurements fall between two sizes, choose the smaller size for a tighter fit or the larger size for a looser fit.
